**sdd/issue-250-b0/proposal**

**What**: Proposal for SDD change issue-250-b0 (Track B / B0 — write the harness port contract down). Built on the measurement (#584), owner reframe (#585), and 3 binding pins (#587); does NOT reopen them.

**Why**: The SDD_HARNESS port is ONE op (init) BY DESIGN, not a bug (VALID_OPS=['init'] at cli.mjs:52; all artifact work is hardcoded harness-neutral). The contract is implicit in 6 hard-coding sites and inconsistent across gates. B0 writes it down and proves the port with a 2nd inhabitant on init.

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-250-b0/proposal.md (created).

**4 deliverables**: (D1) sdd-layout.md normative — flat spec.md canonical, nested specs/*/spec.md legacy-accepted w/ flat preference (Pin 1); (D2) sdd-layout.mjs single REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS accessor + drift-guard, 4-artifact check NEW-changes-only, 12 legacy dirs grandfathered never rewritten (Pin 2); (D3) ADR draft — single-op init port owning 4 surfaces (instructions/bootstrap/memory/capabilities), artifacts neutral by design, CITES Track A pure-evaluator/thin-wrapper analogy applied to the executor (Pin 3); (D4) plain.mjs REAL selectable backend — SDD_HARNESS=plain dispatches init emitting workflow-guide §B 9-step manifest → port reaches n=2 on init.

**Non-goals**: B1 (6 sites migration + instruction-emission adapter), B2 (Antigravity baptism, #247 candidate), B3 (deferred), spec.md micro-fix (shipped #251).

**Two open forks flagged for owner**: (A) exact normative wording of the 4-surface port definition — draft proposed, marked for owner sign-off; (B) grandfather mechanism (allowlist vs date-range vs era-aware module) — options + recommendation (static allowlist centralized in sdd-layout.mjs, extending the existing BASELINE_EXEMPT_DIRS precedent), marked for design/owner decision.

**Learned**: The reframe dissolves #584's apparent scope-gap — no VALID_OPS expansion needed because artifact-neutrality is intentional; n=2 proven on init via plain.mjs. PLAN-adapters-v3 §3 B2/B3 numbering superseded (plain folds into B0, B2=Antigravity, B3 deferred), but its "adapters normalize into fixed layout" claim stands. Budget ≤400, no size:exception, TDD.
